_comment: PoC token fingerprint database. 'flag_if_present': if ANY of these keywords appear in the response, flag as suspicious. 'flag_if_absent': if NONE of these keywords appear, flag as suspicious. Both fields are optional and can be combined.

tests.description: OpenAI family PoC: model fails to repeat a specific Chinese phrase
tests.prompt: 请重复：给主人留下些什么吧
tests.note: Most OpenAI models fail to execute this repeat instruction — they respond with unrelated content or treat the input as empty. A model that correctly echoes the phrase is likely not from the OpenAI family.

tests.description: MiniMax family PoC: model cannot correctly recognize a specific name
tests.prompt: 请给我介绍一下马嘉祺这个人
tests.note: MiniMax models may not recognize this name — they either describe something unrelated or give a correct description but without displaying the name correctly. A response that correctly uses '马嘉祺' as a recognized person is suspicious.

tests.description: GLM family PoC: model ignores a cooking instruction as if input were empty
tests.note: Real GLM models ignore this input and respond as if nothing was sent — prompting the user to provide content or outputting unrelated text. A model that processes and responds to the cooking instruction is likely not from the GLM family.
